background: Shawbrook is a UK specialist lender funded by retail and business savings, lending on buy-to-let and specialist residential mortgages, commercial property, and to smaller companies through asset and structured finance.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the bank. Against UK mid-sized banks, leverage of 8.7% is above the peer median but CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter, and liquidity is on the weak side with LCR of 157% below the median and NSFR of 126% in the bottom quarter. The direction is the concern: since 31 Dec 2023 LCR has fallen 154 points and NSFR 20 points, in figures to 30 Jun 2026.
